info.name: Audit Log Service - end-to-end
info.description: End-to-end verification of the audit-log service (same API on the Java service, default http://localhost:8080, and the Python service, default http://localhost:8000). Run folders in order (Collection Runner / newman). 'init' creates a fresh runId so every run uses new actors and resources and can be repeated against the same database. Keys come from the environment (dev sample keys). Hash chains, content hashes, leaf commitments, recordsDigest and genesis are recomputed independently in JS. Ed25519 signatures are NOT verified here (not available in the Postman sandbox): use the offline verifier CLI with the pinned public key. Folder 07 'over the limit' only fails over if AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX_RECORDS is lower than 8. Folder 11 documents known defects and is expected to fail. The collection never archives real data or deletes anything.
